policy: All gun/ammo IDs use registry names, not the legacy numeric ItemID fields in content text.
No new FMUR explosives, launchers, tracer/special ammo or high-damage sniper rifles in this default suggestion.
No new AE2 presses, processors, storage cells, machines or power units. Raw Certus, dust, silicon and small rare Fluix drops only.
AE2/Nuclear rare retained rewards remain at their existing weights; proposed items gain their explicitly listed replacement weight.
Nutrition and actual weapon gameplay are not fully tested. Kit support and restriction-route fixes must be validated before installation.
